title: ROOF PANEL TRIM & LOCKS
summary: Coupe (19437) removable roof panels (T-tops): the roof panel locks (paddle latches), guide header pin, front roof center lock with shims, and the roof panel trim (headliner panel on the underside of the T-top) held by clips and screws. Locks are adjusted for a 13-16 lb release load and the panels must sit within ±.03 in. of flush with the rear roof panel.
